description: Summarise how one event's prices moved: for each outcome and bookmaker, the first price in the window, the latest, the high and low and how many changes, from SockOdds' recorded price history (not every tick). By default reads the 24 hours before the start (or up to now before the start) for the head to head market at Australian bookmakers. Needs a paid plan or the Pro trial; recorded history costs 10 times the live price in credits.

bookmakers.description: Optional comma separated bookmaker keys, at most 20, instead of region

hours.description: Hours of history to read, ending at `to`. Default 24 (the most SockOdds allows in one window).

market.description: h2h, h2h_3way, line or total. Default h2h.

region.description: Show bookmakers in this region. Default au. Use all for every bookmaker.

to.description: End of the window in UTC, for example 2026-11-19T00:30:00Z. Default: the start time, or now if the event has not started.

name: odds_history
title: Price history
